title: Internal documents: Chinese hacker-for-hire company ZRON is selling stolen foreign intelligence and using AI systems to make the data more accessible for police (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Internal documents: Chinese hacker-for-hire company ZRON is selling stolen foreign intelligence and using AI systems to make the data more accessible for police — Internal company materials show AI being used to make stolen foreign government data digestible for police, targeting Russia, Pakistan and others
